briefing.title: Briefing after cycle 011 — what the world is pressing on

question: Which of these two should the world act on first, in the coming year?

matters.title: Ebola has left eastern Congo
matters.gist: The Bundibugyo outbreak in Congo now has cases in Kenya and Nigeria, and no licensed vaccine exists for this strain.

matters.title: El Niño heads for a historic peak
matters.gist: NOAA expects a strong to very strong El Niño into early 2027, on oceans that set a September record.

matters.title: COP31 meets on a 2.8 °C path
matters.gist: Current policies lead far past the Paris goal as the climate talks meet in Antalya.

matters.title: Monitored wildlife populations down 73 % on average
matters.gist: The Living Planet Index shows monitored vertebrate populations shrinking on average, most of all in Latin America and in fresh water.

matters.title: Record West Nile in Europe, diphtheria in Nigeria
matters.gist: Europe has its worst West Nile season on record, and diphtheria has spread widely in Nigeria.

matters.title: The forcibly displaced
matters.gist: More than one in every seventy people on Earth has been forced to flee, most of them inside their own countries.

matters.title: AI in the American vote
matters.gist: Political ads made or enhanced with AI have grown from almost nothing in 2024, and no federal rule requires a disclaimer.

matters.title: AI and the first rung of work
matters.gist: Employment of the youngest workers in the jobs most exposed to AI has fallen behind their peers, apparently through fewer hires.

matters.title: AI’s power bill
matters.gist: The electricity data centres use is rising fast, and the AI-focused ones fastest.

matters.title: The war on Iran as an energy shock far away
matters.gist: Ship traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has collapsed, oil has found other routes, and the cost falls hardest on energy importers.

estimates.label: Confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC
estimates.question: How many confirmed Ebola cases had the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported in this outbreak by 29 October 2026?

estimates.label: People forcibly displaced worldwide
estimates.question: How many people were forcibly displaced worldwide at the end of 2025?

estimates.label: Spending on AI political ads
estimates.question: How much had been spent on American political ads made or enhanced with AI by 29 October 2026, in dollars?

estimates.label: The gap for the youngest workers
estimates.question: In American payroll data, how far behind less exposed peers does employment of workers aged 22 to 25 in the jobs most exposed to AI stand, in percent?

estimates.label: The central Pacific above normal
estimates.question: In NOAA's discussion of 8 October 2026, how many degrees above normal stood the central Pacific (Niño-3.4)?
